/-!
# MODULE: expert_cache_residency
VRAM expert tier: a (layer, expert) -> slot residency table, a no-eviction admission counter, and the
per-layer slot ranges of R4.2g. Also the 256-byte slot alignment of `open_sized`.

## Source semantics
* `admit` never evicts: a resident pair keeps its slot, a full cache answers "not resident".
* Per-layer admission: layer `l` may only use `[l*q, (l+1)*q)` with `q = slots / n_layers`, the last layer taking
  the remainder, so the ranges tile `0..slots` exactly.
* `slot_of` is bounds-checked: layer and expert are separate axes, the flat index is `layer*n_expert + expert`.
* `open_sized` rounds each slot up to 256 bytes, so the arena is at least the sum of the blob sizes.

## Form template identifiers
* `ExpertCache::admit` -> `admitBounded` / `admitResident`
* `ExpertCache::layer_slot_range` -> `layerLo` / `layerHi`
* `ExpertCache::slot_of` flat index -> `layer * nExpert + expert`
* `open_sized` offset rounding -> `align256`, `totalAligned`
-/

namespace Strata.ExpertCache

-- § per-layer slot ranges

/-- `q = slots / n_layers`, the quota of each layer under per-layer admission. -/
def perLayerQuota (slots nLayers : Nat) : Nat := slots / nLayers

/-- Lower end of layer `layer`'s slot range. -/
def layerLo (slots nLayers layer : Nat) : Nat := layer * perLayerQuota slots nLayers

/-- Upper end (exclusive) of layer `layer`'s range; the last layer takes the remainder. -/
def layerHi (slots nLayers layer : Nat) : Nat :=
  if layer + 1 = nLayers then slots else (layer + 1) * perLayerQuota slots nLayers

/-- `q * n_layers` never exceeds the slot count. -/
theorem quota_mul_le (slots n : Nat) : perLayerQuota slots n * n ≤ slots :=
  Nat.div_mul_le_self slots n

/-- Helper: `layer * q ≤ slots` whenever `layer ≤ n_layers`. -/
theorem lo_le_slots (slots n layer : Nat) (h : layer ≤ n) : layerLo slots n layer ≤ slots := by
  unfold layerLo
  have h1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (perLayerQuota slots n) h
  have h2 := quota_mul_le slots n
  have h3 : n * perLayerQuota slots n = perLayerQuota slots n * n := Nat.mul_comm _ _
  omega

/-- Each layer's range is well formed: `lo ≤ hi`. -/
theorem lo_le_hi (slots n layer : Nat) (h : layer < n) :
    layerLo slots n layer ≤ layerHi slots n layer := by
  unfold layerHi
  split
  · exact lo_le_slots slots n layer (Nat.le_of_lt h)
  · unfold layerLo
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ layer)

/-- Each layer's range stays inside the arena. -/
theorem hi_le_slots (slots n layer : Nat) (h : layer < n) : layerHi slots n layer ≤ slots := by
  unfold layerHi
  split
  · exact Nat.le_refl _
  · have hl : layer + 1 ≤ n := h
    have h1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (perLayerQuota slots n) hl
    have h2 := quota_mul_le slots n
    have h3 : n * perLayerQuota slots n = perLayerQuota slots n * n := Nat.mul_comm _ _
    omega

/-- Consecutive ranges abut: no slot is orphaned between layers. -/
theorem hi_eq_next_lo (slots n layer : Nat) (h : layer + 1 < n) :
    layerHi slots n layer = layerLo slots n (layer + 1) := by
  unfold layerHi layerLo
  rw [if_neg (by omega)]

/-- The last layer's range ends exactly at `slots`. -/
theorem last_hi (slots n : Nat) (h : 0 < n) : layerHi slots n (n - 1) = slots := by
  unfold layerHi
  rw [if_pos (by omega)]

/-- The first layer's range starts at 0. -/
theorem first_lo (slots n : Nat) : layerLo slots n 0 = 0 := by
  simp [layerLo]

/-- Distinct layers' ranges never overlap. -/
theorem ranges_disjoint (slots n a b : Nat) (hab : a < b) (hb : b < n) :
    layerHi slots n a ≤ layerLo slots n b := by
  unfold layerHi layerLo
  rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hab

-- § admission

/-- Claim the slot `cur` if it is below the ceiling `hi`; the new counter is `cur + 1`. -/
def admitBounded (cur hi : Nat) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
  if hi ≤ cur then none else some (cur, cur + 1)

/-- A granted slot lies in `[lo, hi)` when the counter started at or above `lo`; the counter advances by one. -/
theorem admitBounded_spec {cur lo hi s cur' : Nat} (hlo : lo ≤ cur)
    (h : admitBounded cur hi = some (s, cur')) : lo ≤ s ∧ s < hi ∧ cur' = s + 1 := by
  by_cases hc : hi ≤ cur
  · simp [admitBounded, hc] at h
  · simp [admitBounded, hc] at h
    omega

/-- Admission is refused exactly when the quota (or the whole cache) is full. -/
theorem admitBounded_none_iff (cur hi : Nat) : admitBounded cur hi = none ↔ hi ≤ cur := by
  unfold admitBounded
  split <;> simp_all

/-- No eviction: an already resident pair keeps its slot whatever the counter says. -/
def admitResident (r : Option Nat) (fresh : Option Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match r with
  | some s => some s
  | none => fresh

theorem admitResident_keeps {r : Option Nat} {s : Nat} (fresh : Option Nat) (h : r = some s) :
    admitResident r fresh = some s := by
  simp [admitResident, h]

    layer * ne + expert < n * ne := by
  have hl' : layer + 1 ≤ n := hl
  have h2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right ne hl'
  rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] at h2
  omega

/-- Round a byte count up to a multiple of 256. -/
def align256 (x : Nat) : Nat := (x + 255) / 256 * 256

/-- Rounding never shrinks a slot. -/
theorem align256_ge (x : Nat) : x ≤ align256 x := by
  unfold align256; omega

/-- Rounded sizes are multiples of 256. -/
theorem align256_mod (x : Nat) : align256 x % 256 = 0 := by
  unfold align256; omega

/-- Rounding wastes fewer than 256 bytes. -/
theorem align256_lt (x : Nat) : align256 x < x + 256 := by
  unfold align256; omega

  | b :: bs => b + totalRaw bs

  | [] => 0
  | b :: bs => align256 b + totalAligned bs

/-- The arena holds every blob: aligned total is at least the raw total. -/
theorem totalAligned_ge (bs : List Nat) : totalRaw bs ≤ totalAligned bs := by
  induction bs with
  | nil => simp [totalRaw, totalAligned]
  | cons b bs ih =>
    simp only [totalRaw, totalAligned]
    have := align256_ge b
    omega

end Strata.ExpertCache

/-!
# MODULE: expert_source_blob_index
Blob addressing of the expert sources (file-mapped and arena) and the arithmetic of the verify window's
GPU/PCIe split of missed experts.

## Source semantics
* The blob index is `layer * n_expert + expert` and `expert < n_expert` is checked on its own axis: otherwise
  `blob(l, n_expert)` aliases `blob(l+1, 0)`.
* On valid pairs the index is injective and below `blobs = n_layers * n_expert`.
* The PCIe share of the misses is `(nmiss * pcie_num) >> 8`, which never exceeds `nmiss` for `pcie_num <= 256`.
* Hits are skipped by the pool: `njobs + hits = k`.

## Form template identifiers
* `FileExpertSource::blob`, `ArenaExpertSource::blob` -> `blobIndex`
* `expert_pool_dispatch_multi` PCIe count `m` -> `pcieShare`
* `expert_pool_dispatch` job counter -> `jobCount`
-/

namespace Strata.ExpertSource

-- § blob index

/-- Flat blob index of `(layer, expert)`. -/
def blobIndex (nExpert layer expert : Nat) : Nat := layer * nExpert + expert

/-- Helper: an in-layer expert index stays below the next layer's start. -/
theorem idx_lt_next (ne l e : Nat) (he : e < ne) : blobIndex ne l e < (l + 1) * ne := by
  unfold blobIndex
  rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
  omega

/-- Helper: layer starts are monotone. -/
theorem start_mono (ne a b : Nat) (h : a ≤ b) : a * ne ≤ b * ne := Nat.mul_le_mul_right ne h

/-- Why the separate `expert >= n_expert` check matters: one past the end aliases the next layer's first expert. -/
theorem overflow_aliases (ne l : Nat) : blobIndex ne l ne = blobIndex ne (l + 1) 0 := by
  unfold blobIndex
  rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
  omega

/-- In-range pairs index inside the blob table. -/
theorem blobIndex_lt (n ne l e : Nat) (hl : l < n) (he : e < ne) : blobIndex ne l e < n * ne := by
  have h1 := idx_lt_next ne l e he
  have hl' : l + 1 ≤ n := hl
  have h2 := start_mono ne (l + 1) n hl'
  omega

/-- On valid pairs distinct `(layer, expert)` get distinct blobs (no aliasing). -/
theorem blobIndex_injective (ne l1 e1 l2 e2 : Nat) (h1 : e1 < ne) (h2 : e2 < ne)
    (h : blobIndex ne l1 e1 = blobIndex ne l2 e2) : l1 = l2 ∧ e1 = e2 := by
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy l1 l2 with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exfalso
    have a := idx_lt_next ne l1 e1 h1
    have b := start_mono ne (l1 + 1) l2 hlt
    have c : l2 * ne ≤ blobIndex ne l2 e2 := by unfold blobIndex; omega
    omega
  · subst heq
    unfold blobIndex at h
    omega
  · exfalso
    have a := idx_lt_next ne l2 e2 h2
    have b := start_mono ne (l2 + 1) l1 hgt
    have c : l1 * ne ≤ blobIndex ne l1 e1 := by unfold blobIndex; omega
    omega

-- § GPU/PCIe split

/-- Number of missed experts the GPU reads over PCIe: `(nmiss * pcie_num) >> 8`. -/
def pcieShare (nmiss pcieNum : Nat) : Nat := nmiss * pcieNum / 256

/-- The PCIe share never exceeds the number of misses when `pcie_num <= 256`. -/
theorem pcieShare_le (nmiss pcieNum : Nat) (h : pcieNum ≤ 256) : pcieShare nmiss pcieNum ≤ nmiss := by
  unfold pcieShare
  apply Nat.div_le_of_le_mul
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left nmiss h
  omega

/-- With no PCIe numerator the CPU keeps every miss. -/
theorem pcieShare_zero (nmiss : Nat) : pcieShare nmiss 0 = 0 := by
  simp [pcieShare]

-- § hit / miss partition

/-- Jobs the CPU pool runs: every routed expert that is not a hit. -/
def jobCount (k hits : Nat) : Nat := k - hits

/-- Jobs plus hits account for every routed expert exactly once. -/
theorem jobs_add_hits (k hits : Nat) (h : hits ≤ k) : jobCount k hits + hits = k := by
  unfold jobCount; omega

/-- A layer with no hits gives the pool all `k` experts. -/
theorem jobs_no_hits (k : Nat) : jobCount k 0 = k := by
  simp [jobCount]

end Strata.ExpertSource

/-!
# MODULE: weight_loader_segments
Byte accounting of the dense-weight loader: quantized tensors are loaded as codes / scales / offset segments,
promoted float tensors shrink from 4 to 2 bytes per element, and fp16 scale planes widen to f32.

## Source semantics
* The segment lists must cover both recorded totals (`sum_src`, `sum_dst`) or the loader refuses.
* An fp16 scale plane has `scales_bytes / 2` source bytes and an even `scales_bytes`.
* A promoted tensor is `4*elems` in and `2*elems` out; Bf16High/ToF16 map `n` source bytes to `n/2`.
* WidenF16 maps `n` (even) source bytes to `2n` output bytes; staging output is `2*CHUNK` so it never overflows.
* Compaction aligns each kept tensor to `align` (default 256).

## Form template identifiers
* `Seg` sums -> `quantSrcTotal` / `quantDstTotal`
* `Conv::Bf16High`/`ToF16` -> `narrowOut`, `Conv::WidenF16` -> `widenOut`
* `CHUNK` -> `chunk`, `a = align` -> `align256`
-/

namespace Strata.WeightLoader

-- § quantized tensor segments

/-- Source bytes of a quantized tensor: codes, then (possibly half-width) scales, then the offset plane. -/

/-!
# MODULE: session_layer_contracts
Numeric and protocol contracts of the session loop, the doorbell handoff, the speculative verify window and
the MTP drafter (layer.hpp, session.hpp, verify.hpp, mtp.hpp).

## Source semantics
* 48 layers = 12 QSA + 36 GDN.
* Doorbell: the device `doorbell_wait` passes iff the host's flag equals the ring value; the host writes the
  ring value after serving; rings are strictly increasing so a stale flag blocks.
* Verify window: `1 <= T <= max_t <= 8` (exec table has 9 entries); `commit(n_keep)` needs `1 <= n_keep <= T`;
  a window of T tokens carries `T - 1` drafts.
* R0.11 stage prefixes: stage `i` time is `prefix(i+1) - prefix(i)`, so the five stage times telescope to
  `prefix 5 - prefix 0`.
* Parts buffer: `k * n_embd` floats.

## Form template identifiers
* `Doorbell::h_seq`/`h_flag` -> `ring`/`flag`
* `Verifier::run`/`commit` -> `windowOk`/`commitOk`
* `session_replay_stage_prefixes` -> `stageTime`/`sumStages`
* `SessionLoopScratch::parts_bytes` -> `partsBytes`
-/

namespace Strata.SessionContracts

-- § layer split

/-- Number of QSA layers. -/
def nQsa : Nat := 12
/-- Number of GDN layers. -/
def nGdn : Nat := 36

/-- The two layer kinds cover all 48 layers. -/
theorem layers_total : nQsa + nGdn = 48 := by
  unfold nQsa nGdn; rfl

-- § doorbell protocol

/-- The device wait passes when the host's flag equals the ring value. -/
def devicePasses (flag ring : Nat) : Prop := flag = ring

/-- After serving ring `r` the host's flag is `r`. -/
def hostServe (_flag ring : Nat) : Nat := ring

/-- The next ring value. -/
def nextRing (r : Nat) : Nat := r + 1

/-- Once the host has served a ring, the device wait passes. -/
theorem served_passes (flag ring : Nat) : devicePasses (hostServe flag ring) ring := by
  unfold devicePasses hostServe; rfl

/-- A flag left over from the previous ring does not satisfy the next ring. -/
theorem stale_flag_blocks (r : Nat) : ¬ devicePasses r (nextRing r) := by
  unfold devicePasses nextRing; omega

/-- After `doorbell_reset`, the zeroed flag does not satisfy the first ring (value 1). -/
theorem reset_blocks_first : ¬ devicePasses 0 (nextRing 0) := by
  unfold devicePasses nextRing; omega

-- § verify window

/-- Window parameters accepted by `Verifier::init`/`run`. -/
def windowOk (T maxT : Nat) : Prop := 1 ≤ T ∧ T ≤ maxT ∧ maxT ≤ 8

/-- Valid windows index the 9-entry graph table in range. -/
theorem window_exec_index (T maxT : Nat) (h : windowOk T maxT) : T < 9 := by
  unfold windowOk at h; omega

/-- `commit(n_keep)`: keep a non-empty prefix of the window. -/
def commitOk (nKeep T : Nat) : Prop := 1 ≤ nKeep ∧ nKeep ≤ T

/-- Drafts carried by a window of `T` tokens. -/
def draftCount (T : Nat) : Nat := T - 1

/-- The window is the last accepted token plus the drafts. -/
theorem window_is_drafts_plus_one (T : Nat) (h : 1 ≤ T) : draftCount T + 1 = T := by
  unfold draftCount; omega

/-- Rejected rows are never committed: the kept prefix leaves `T - nKeep` rows to be overwritten. -/
theorem commit_rest (nKeep T : Nat) (h : commitOk nKeep T) : nKeep + (T - nKeep) = T := by
  unfold commitOk at h; omega

-- § stage prefixes

/-- Time of stage `i` from the prefix sweep `f`. -/
def stageTime (f : Nat → Int) (i : Nat) : Int := f (i + 1) - f i

/-- Sum of the five stage times. -/
def sumStages (f : Nat → Int) : Int :=
  stageTime f 0 + stageTime f 1 + stageTime f 2 + stageTime f 3 + stageTime f 4

/-- The five stage times telescope to the full-graph prefix minus the empty prefix. -/
theorem stages_telescope (f : Nat → Int) : sumStages f = f 5 - f 0 := by
  simp only [sumStages, stageTime, Nat.reduceAdd]
  omega

-- § parts buffer

/-- Bytes of the pool's `k x n_embd` float staging buffer. -/
def partsBytes (k nEmbd : Nat) : Nat := k * nEmbd * 4

/-- The parts buffer is a whole number of floats. -/
theorem partsBytes_mod (k nEmbd : Nat) : partsBytes k nEmbd % 4 = 0 := by
  unfold partsBytes; omega

end Strata.SessionContracts
